summary: A native control plane managing and orchestrating AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, providing local-first coordination and developer tooling.
usecases: Centralized management of multiple AI coding agents in a development workflow
Local-first execution of coding tasks with privacy and offline support
Coordination of agent-based pipelines for automated refactoring or code generation
ideas: Build a dashboard to monitor and switch between different coding agents in real-time
Integrate with CI/CD pipelines to trigger agent-based code reviews or PR generation
Enable plugin architecture for custom coding agents to register with the control plane
